link.note: The tree (and an earlier screenshot version of the Bull Smith chart) shows 'Justice, A Smith 1649–1726' as father of James Smith (1688). The uploaded PDF corrects this to Job Smith (c.1647–c.1719) + Elizabeth Thompson; F. K. Smith gives 'James Smith (Job, Richard)'. Round 1 correction 3f: the PDF is right. Not John's ancestor.

summary: Bull Smith's son Adam (b. 1649) — John's 9th-great-grand-uncle — wrongly shown in the tree as James Smith's father.
bio: Bull Smith had a son Adam, b. 1649; William Hammond's will (1662) left 'Adam Smith, son of daughter, Sarah' a mare colt and £20 'if he behave obediently to my wife'. The tree's 'Justice A Smith' card carries a Smithtown 350th logo image and pairs him with Elizabeth Thompson 1657–1718. Preferred: Job Smith is James's father; Adam is a collateral uncle.
